item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Amnesty International’s 29 May 2023 submission highlighted Brazil’s failure to address extrajudicial executions and other violations committed in the context of policing and the so-called “war on drugs,” especially their disproportionate and discriminatory impact on Black people driven by systemic racism.","notes":["The excerpt supports the submission date, attribution to Amnesty International, the policing and “war on drugs” context, and the systemic-racism wording.","Narrowed “continuing” to the excerpt’s wording, “failure to address,” and specified that the violations were committed in that context."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt directly supports the reported shrinking space for civil-society organizations and human-rights defenders and the concerns regarding Indigenous, Quilombola, and other traditional peoples."]}]}
